verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can schedule recurring tasks that run in the background, and users can review active, paused, and completed tasks and their recent runs in Scheduled. Tasks can also start automatically on Gmail, Slack, or GitHub events. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off (single-run) scheduling, documentation of how results are delivered back to the user (e.g. notifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
